title: Ledger Finds Tampered Hardware Wallets in Berlin, Probes Two in Dubai
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Ledger Finds Tampered Hardware Wallets in Berlin, Probes Two in Dubai Ledger confirmed tampered hardware wallets in Berlin and is investigating two more in Dubai, widening a probe into spy implants that steal recovery phrases. This post Ledger Finds Tampered Hardware Wallets in Berlin, Probes Two in Dubai first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
